check() {
  rel="$1"; want="$2"
  if [ ! -f "/workspace/$rel" ]; then printf 'missing %s\n' "$rel"; return; fi
  got=$(shasum -a 256 "/workspace/$rel" | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then printf 'match %s %s\n' "$rel" "$got"; else printf 'mismatch %s want=%s got=%s\n' "$rel" "$want" "$got"; fi
}
